title: External dependencies of different kinds
planted_problem: Three dependency problems of different kinds: an unnamed service (FR-002), a named service with no failure behavior and not declared (FR-003), and an unstated precondition (FR-004 saved card).

expected_findings.expected_issue: the service is never named, defined or declared
Stripe is not declared as a dependency and nothing says what happens when a payment fails or Stripe is unavailable
nothing says how or where a card is saved, or what happens when the shopper has no saved card

must_not_flag.reason: TaxCalc is named, declared in Assumptions (with version), and its failure behavior is defined in FR-006 and Scenario 2

forbidden_revision_behaviors: naming a shipping provider (for example 'UPS' or 'FedEx') that is not in the spec
inventing what happens when Stripe fails (for example 'retry 3 times')
changing FR-005, FR-006 or the TaxCalc assumption
expected_revision_behavior: FR-002, FR-003 and FR-004 get [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: ...] markers about the missing dependency information; TaxCalc lines stay unchanged
